Name: T's Farmhouse Annex
Author: tikamin557
Description:
Adds an expandable map that grows alongside your Farmhouse upgrade level.
The map can contain up to 5 small rooms, and each room can be decorated freely just like the Farmhouse. You can change the wallpaper and flooring, place beds and furniture, and customize each room however you like.
When the Farmhouse reaches Upgrade Level 3 (the stage where the vanilla cellar is added), Casks can also be used in this map.

Through the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] settings, you can customize the rooms in various ways, such as adding a kitchen, adding a hot spring, enabling crop cultivation like a Greenhouse, and several other options.
There are two main files available: the CP version and the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20537]PIF[/url] version. Please install only one of them.
If both versions are installed, the CP version is automatically disabled to prevent conflicts.

[size=4]For even more customization, use "[i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/49105]T's Farmhouse Annex - Beam Color Pack[/url]"[/i].[/size]
[size=4]It lets you set the beam color of each room and the hallway individually from 26 different colo[/size]rs.


Currently, the included i18n files support:
[list]
[*]English (default)[/*]
[*]Japanese[/*]
[/list]
